items.text: Devs added screen shake toggle, my eyeballs thank you.  Fun game, and with screen shake turned off you don't even have to vomit while piloting the ship!
items.text_zh: 开发者加了屏幕震动开关，我的眼球感谢你们。好玩的游戏，而且关掉屏幕震动后，你驾驶飞船时甚至都不用吐了！

observations.evidence: with screen shake turned off you don't even have to vomit while piloting the ship!
observations.evidence_zh: 关掉屏幕震动后，你甚至不必在驾驶飞船时呕吐了！
observations.change_evidence_zh: 开发者添加了屏幕震动开关
